content.text:
Subagent orchestration gate
Result: use-subagent-orchestrator
Reason: Strong orchestration signals detected (release/data risk, review/audit, tests/verification).

Why parallel:
- independent track 1: map migration, schema compatibility, and rollback boundaries
- independent track 2: review release/data risk and identify missing tests
Blockers checked: explicit user opt-out, child-agent recursion, strict sequential dependencies, conflicting writes, workspace-write dirty-state isolation, external side effects, privacy/tool limits, unbounded broad agent tasks.
Read-only agents must report whether findings depend on uncommitted changes.
Subagents:
- so_mapper
  mode: read-only
  scope: migration and schema compatibility boundaries
  expected output: affected files, contracts, uncertainty
  constraints: no recursive fan-out
- so_reviewer
  mode: read-only
  scope: rollback and compatibility risk
  expected output: material findings only
  constraints: no recursive fan-out
- so_tester
  mode: read-only
  scope: missing migration tests
  expected output: targeted test commands and gaps
  constraints: no recursive fan-out
